title: ilex dubia var. macropoda
intro: Ilex dubia var. macropoda, commonly known as the 'Himalayan Holly', is a plant species belonging to the family Aquifoliaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ilex dubia var. macropoda, including ursolic acid and isoverbenone, have been identified to contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in the development of new herbal remedies.
